pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal patches with sharp edge gradients and high angularity. Flank patches exhibit multi-vertex geometries and large relative spatial area, while patches on the lower neck are vertically elongated and rhomboidal.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light cream-colored interstitial pathways. Junction nodes consist of tri-radial and quadri-radial intersections. Pixel thickness is variable, appearing wider on the mid-flank and narrowing significantly toward the neck.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Continuous, low-amplitude, and high-frequency serrated profile along the dorsal neck, composed of dense, short hair tufts creating a jagged 1D contour.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple pale, linear cicatrices are visible on the mid-flank, including a prominent vertical scar and several smaller intersecting horizontal and diagonal marks.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, dark-pigmented pendulous preputial sheath is visible on the ventral midline.
